parsed.name: Arduino 旋转编码器
parsed.description: 一种通过 Arduino 采集脉冲信号的旋转编码器或轮速编码器，用于测量轴或车轮的转动、速度与里程变化，常见于小车、机器人和运动控制实验。
parsed.description_en: A rotary or wheel encoder read through an Arduino, used to measure shaft or wheel rotation, speed, and distance changes. It is commonly used in small vehicles, robotics, and motion-control experiments.

actions.description: 更新编码器的最新转动或速度读数。
actions.description_en: Update the latest rotation or speed reading from the encoder.

actions.description: 返回后台采集到的最新编码器读数。
actions.description_en: Return the latest encoder reading acquired in the background.

actions.description: 停止编码器的后台采集。
actions.description_en: Stop background acquisition from the encoder.
